"Fried, E.I. (Eiko)" <e.i.fried@fsw.leidenuniv.nl>:
Dear Avicenna team, A member in the WARN-D team, our postdoc Rayyan (in CC), was trying to download the data for our study (ID: 2385) using the link provided (http://ethicadata.com/media/public/2385_data.zip). We noticed that not all data is downloaded, with only data up to the 2nd of August available despite the study running until the 3rd of September. When compared to direct downloads via the Avicenna Dashboard, we see that we do indeed have data dated as late as the 3rd of September, and it is therefore not an issue of compliance. As our processing pipelines would need to work on data in a consistent manner, and the direct download seems to be formatted differently, we were wondering if it is possible to receive and updated version of the data as before, using the link. Thanks Eiko PS: please respond to all so that Rayyan also receives the response, thanks __ Dr ​Eiko Fried Associate Professor Department of Clinical Psychology Leiden University Mentor research master students clinical & health track Young Academy Leiden & Open Science Community Leiden Project Responsible Scholarship Meet me in my zoom My website: Blog, publications, lectures, code, & data WARN-D: Building an early warning system for depression CV | Google Scholar | Twitter/X | Bluesky | Youtube | My team------

Amin Ghaffari:
Mohammad Hashemian I think Faham used to keep the file served at that address updated, now that he's on leave, not sure who can update the file.I can provide them with the filterbox API, API key and the CURL command to get the same data as downloaded from the dashboard but I don't think that would be the best thing to do. Should I ask Omid or Pouya to update the file or you will? Please advise. Thanks.------
